issues.where: center foreground, just above the soil mound
issues.what: At phone size the opening reads as a sunrise over soil: the seedling is only a small pale sliver, while the sun and taller edge shoots draw the eye. The sprout becomes legible by 0.27 s, and its rapid rise rewards staying without sound.
issues.fix: Start with just enough of the curved sprout and seed coat above the soil to register at 400 px, while preserving the fast rise that follows.
